findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT logs list 12 unique hostnames with 1 risky hostname: staging.copperline.example, pattern staging, first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly logged staging hostname may expose a less-hardened environment or test data for this supply-chain SaaS, increasing attack-surface and diligence follow-up risk; validate reachability and segmentation pre-close.

remediation.summary: Verify staging.copperline.example is not publicly reachable, enforce authentication/VPN, remove sensitive data, and restrict future certificate exposure.

items.action: Verify staging.copperline.example is not publicly reachable, enforce authentication/VPN, remove sensitive data, and restrict future certificate exposure.

deal_recommendations.text: Before reliance on the B rating, obtain the current SOC 2 Type II report and complete a management security interview within Days 0–30 [F-001].

Following close, verify staging.copperline.example is not publicly reachable, enforce authentication/VPN, remove sensitive data, and restrict future certificate exposure by Days 61–100, at a cost of $10K–$50K [F-001].
No adjustment to price is warranted, as total remediation of $10K–$50K scheduled for Days 61–100 is immaterial relative to the 50M-250M revenue band [F-001].

narrative.executive_summary: Bottom line: Proceed with conditions. The B rating (98.4) reflects a single medium-severity outside-in finding, but confidence is low and the cap for limited evidence from outside-in signals only limits reliance [F-001]. Key risks: A publicly logged staging hostname suggests a potentially less-hardened environment to validate for reachability and segmentation. Assessment is passive and outside-in only, with Govern, Detect and Recover unassessed, and no SOC 2 report was provided, limiting assurance [F-001]. Management credibility: Not assessed: no management interview provided. Next steps: Provide the current SOC 2 Type II report, complete a management security interview, and verify the staging hostname is not publicly reachable, with authentication and segmentation confirmed pre-close [F-001].
key_questions_for_management: Provide the current SOC 2 Type II report and evidence covering Govern, Detect and Recover [F-001]?
Confirm whether staging.copperline.example is publicly reachable and describe its authentication, network segmentation and data contents [F-001]?
Provide the remediation plan, owner and timeline for the staging hostname through Days 61–100 [F-001]?
Reconcile the outside-in hostname inventory against the complete external attack surface and certificate issuance process [F-001]?

limitations: Unassessed CSF functions (no evidence from provided inputs): GV, DE, RC
Passive outside-in assessment only; no authenticated or internal testing
KEV matches are product-level; versions not verified
